messages:
jess: Quick PSA — we're cutting the release window at 16:00 UTC today. Please do a last-pass on your changelog entries and make sure they follow the short template. If you need a version bump (patch vs minor) ping me here.

omar: on it. pushed a tiny fix in PR #4921 — can someone confirm the suggested changelog line? 'runtime: fix kv-cache eviction causing spikes'

liam: bump rules recap: bugfix/back-compat -> patch; new behavior/feature -> minor; docs/typo -> patch. Breaking changes need a separate coord convo (major).

maya: quick Q — are we enforcing `component:` tags in entries now? I hit a lint earlier.

jess: yes, we're being stricter this cycle. Require `component:` and `area:`. `migration:` is optional but helpful. Copy this minimal entry shape:```- component: runtime
  area: batching
  migration: false
  summary: Fix kv-cache eviction causing spikes```

omar: thanks — I'll update the PR description to that exact shape.

release-bot: :bell: Reminder: changelog-lint runs at cutoff + 5m. Entries that fail will block merges into the release branch. Docs: https://redwood.internal/release-guide#changelogs

liam: tiny process question — if someone lands a backport, who should write the changelog entry for the backport? cc @jess

maya: backports should include an entry by the backport author, but if original author is available they should own it. I'll take infra backports today.

omar: updated entries, added the tags, and bumped to patch. PR diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4921/files :thumbsup:

jess: awesome — I’ll do a sweep at 15:30 UTC to catch anything missed. If you're unsure about bump level, drop the PR link here and I’ll call it. Thanks everyone!
